sentences.en: I always have.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是这样。

sentences.en: I am teaching them that music is an outlet for emotion.
sentences.zh: 我正在教导他们，音乐是情感的宣泄口。

sentences.en: And if I try to stifle my own emotions, I'm being a hypocrite.
sentences.zh: 如果我试图压抑自己的情绪，那我就是个伪君子。

sentences.en: You know, that's how I feel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: And I know you guys are processing a lot of feelings.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们正在消化很多情绪。

sentences.en: And sometimes when we're feeling stuff, things come out and we say things and we say how we feel.
sentences.zh: 有时当我们有某种感受时，事情就会流露出来，我们会说出一些话，表达我们的感受。

sentences.en: And that's okay.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: Listen, kids are kids.
sentences.zh: 听着，孩子就是孩子。

sentences.en: Kids can be a little evil sometimes.
sentences.zh: 孩子们有时会有点淘气。

sentences.en: And, you know, they'll start, you know, teasing people.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们会开始，你知道，取笑别人。

sentences.en: So when someone says something that hurts us or we don't like it, we don't have to accept it.
sentences.zh: 所以当有人说了伤害我们的话或者我们不喜欢的话时，我们不必接受它。

sentences.en: But we don't have to hate them.
sentences.zh: 但我们不必憎恨他们。

sentences.en: Do we have to hate them?
sentences.zh: 我们非得憎恨他们吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Is it possible?
sentences.zh: 这可能吗？

sentences.en: Can that happen?
sentences.zh: 这会发生吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it can happen.
sentences.zh: 是的，这会发生。

sentences.en: And that's the problem in the world.
sentences.zh: 这就是世界上的问题所在。

sentences.en: People aren't listening to each other.
sentences.zh: 人们没有在倾听彼此。

sentences.en: I want them to understand the true value of music.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能理解音乐的真正价值。

sentences.en: And that's what I feel music is.
sentences.zh: 这就是我觉得音乐的意义所在。

sentences.en: It's a bridge.
sentences.zh: 它是一座桥梁。

sentences.en: It's a bridge for people to come together.
sentences.zh: 它是人们走到一起的桥梁。

sentences.en: You guys are really deep thinkers.
sentences.zh: 你们真的是很有思想的人。

sentences.en: Like, you know, when you get it.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，当你理解的时候。

sentences.en: And it gives me hope that you guys are going to get it next.
sentences.zh: 这让我对你们未来能够接手充满希望。

sentences.en: You know, when it's your turn to be the adults and it's your turn to take charge.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当轮到你们成为大人，轮到你们承担责任的时候。

sentences.en: So now most of my course is graduating this week.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我大部分的学生这周都要毕业了。

sentences.en: In the next hour, you are about to witness history of PS22.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一个小时里，你们将见证PS22的历史。

sentences.en: As we celebrate our students, they will leave their legacy at our school by being the first class to celebrate a virtual final assembly.
sentences.zh: 在我们庆祝学生毕业之际，他们将成为第一个举办虚拟毕业典礼的班级，从而在学校留下他们的传承。

sentences.en: Honestly, I don't think I've ever cried so much watching a PS22 performance.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得我从来没有在观看PS22的表演时哭得这么厉害。

sentences.en: Not because it sounds better than what's in the auditorium.
sentences.zh: 不是因为这听起来比礼堂里的更好。

sentences.en: It's just because of how much I miss them.
sentences.zh: 只是因为我太想念他们了。

sentences.en: You see the kids in their houses, full screen, swaying to the music, starting to feel it, starting to get into it.
sentences.zh: 你看到孩子们在各自的家里，全屏显示，随着音乐摇摆，开始感受它，开始沉浸其中。

sentences.en: Running in circles, chasing our tails, coming back as we are.
sentences.zh: 在原地打转，徒劳无功，回归本真。

sentences.en: So to listen to a chorus video is something special on its own.
sentences.zh: 所以，聆听合唱视频本身就是一件特别的事情。

sentences.en: But when you watch it, you're seeing kids just really access a side of themselves that maybe they're not free to do that anywhere else in their lives, to show a real, genuine,
sentences.zh: 但当你观看它时，你会看到孩子们真正触及了他们自己内心的一面，也许他们在生活中其他任何地方都无法自由地展现这一点，去展示一种真实、纯粹、

sentences.en: honest emotion.
sentences.zh: 诚挚的情感。

sentences.en: Music, to me, it's a live team sport.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，音乐是一项现场团队运动。

sentences.en: We need each other, you know, and I want them to know that.
sentences.zh: 我们需要彼此，你知道，我希望他们知道这一点。

sentences.en: I want them to know that when you work together with people, but keep your own individuality
sentences.zh: 我希望他们知道，当你与他人合作，但又保持自己的个性时，

sentences.en: within the context of that large group, share what you have to offer, and be open to what other people have to offer.
sentences.zh: 在那个大集体的背景下，分享你所能提供的，并对他人所能提供的保持开放。

sentences.en: However, that's what it's all about.
sentences.zh: 然而，这就是它的全部意义所在。

sentences.en: That's to me, I think it's truly an allegory for the world, you know, what happens in our room.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我认为这确实是世界的寓言，你知道，在我们的房间里发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's an allegory for the utopian world that we're working towards.
sentences.zh: 这是我们正在努力实现的乌托邦世界的寓言。

sentences.en: Guys, you are incredible people.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，你们是了不起的人。

sentences.en: I am so proud of you, and I'm going to start crying in about two seconds if I keep talking.
sentences.zh: 我为你们感到骄傲，如果我继续说下去，我大概两秒钟内就会开始哭。

sentences.en: So you guys are like the best medicine.
sentences.zh: 所以你们就像最好的良药。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是Benjamin Poulin。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是Mark Ronson。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一个关于对设计的热爱以及围绕它的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都会带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，你会把DJ台变成一个像

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 活生生的、美丽的50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）的《The Reframers》。
